database_tier.verified_capabilities: Custom archive generation (.dump), SHA-256 integrity hashing, manifest tracking

raw_file_storage_tier.details: PostgreSQL backups only restore text and relational records; raw uploaded binary files in STORAGE_PATH or S3 bucket require paired snapshotting or bucket replication

vector_store_tier.details: PostgreSQL maintains authoritative copy of all DocumentChunks; Qdrant collections can be idempotently rebuilt

encryption_key_tier.details: MultiFernet fallback with PREVIOUS_SECRET_KEYS enables zero-downtime key rotation
